items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: I took some lessons from a woman by the name of Madame Tuscana

ctx.x: did you have violin at home or did you
no I didn't some kid had a violin of course the mandolin and the violin fingering is similar and I fooled on his a little while and I worried my parents for stuff

a violin they weren't any too enthusiastic about it finally they said well if you pass if you get out of this grade we'll give you a violin so I don't know how I ever managed to get out of the grade but I did and I won the violin for that and I took some lessons from a woman by the name of Madame Tuscana I know if anybody ever old enough he has this they'll remember Madame Tuscana Madame maybe it was Madame Tuscana she lived on she had her teaching and also a home on Louisiana Avenue right off of Magazine Street…
